AIFF/AIFC demuxer (AiffReader).

Ports symphonia-format-riff aiff/mod+chunks: FORM container (AIFF and AIFC forms), big-endian chunk walk with even padding, COMM (PCM widths 1..32 rounded up, AIFC compression types incl. sowt/ twos/raw/in24/in32/23ni/fl32/fl64/alaw/ulaw), SSND sound data, NAME/AUTH/(c) `/ANNO text tags; MARK/COMT/APPL/ID3 parsed and skipped (no chapters/attachments in this package). PCM packetization (1152 frames/packet), `1/rate timebase, floor packet-aligned seek.
